Semantier Cloud HTTP/3 client third-party licenses

The following license texts accompany curl-cffi 0.16.0 and the Windows x64
native HTTP/3 libraries selected by the package lock. The native library is
curl-impersonate 2.0.0 and includes the dependencies listed below.

curl-cffi 0.16.0: curl-cffi.txt
curl-impersonate 2.0.0: curl-impersonate.txt
curl 8.21.0: curl.txt
BoringSSL (revision 156c7b75ae9b8c3b3f847acf264f17594c3859fb): boringssl.txt
fiat-crypto (vendored by that BoringSSL revision): fiat-crypto.txt
zlib 1.3.1: zlib.txt
brotli 1.2.0: brotli.txt
zstd 1.5.7: zstd.txt
nghttp2 1.63.0: nghttp2.txt
ngtcp2 1.20.0: ngtcp2.txt
nghttp3 1.15.0: nghttp3.txt
cffi 2.1.1: cffi.txt
certifi 2026.5.20: certifi.txt
pycparser 3.0: pycparser.txt

The pinned BoringSSL curve25519 implementation also identifies portions of
SUPERCOP ref10 as public domain. The preceding list is specific to this
HTTP/3 client and is not an inventory of the whole application.
